summary: Plan B backend validation for CrewFit Marathon programme quality (goal-aware shapes + running templates + progression). 26/26 pytest cases pass in test_iter76_plan_b_marathon_shapes.py + Plan A regression 21/21 still passes. Verified: (T1) event_weekly_shape('marathon',*,4) returns correct ordered slots for foundation ([easy_run,long_run,strength_support,easy_run]+mob/rec), build (adds tempo, no intervals), peak (adds intervals, no tempo), deload (no tempo/no intervals but long_run preserved) — unknown event_type falls back to marathon; (T2) strength_weekly_shape('build_muscle',4)=[push_strength,pull_strength,leg_strength,upper_strength]+light, strength_weekly_shape('lose_fat',3)=[upper_strength,conditioning,lower_strength]+light, unknown key → general_fitness; (T3) Louis scenario (main_goal_key=event, event_type_pref=marathon, training_days_per_week=4, hotel_gym_reliable) with 14-day roster (2 long-hauls + 2 layovers) → NO 'Full Body Strength' title, ≥1 Long Run per 7-day window, ≥1 Easy Run per 7-day window, EXACTLY 1 Strength for Runners per 7-day window, real training sessions ≤ 4 per week after _apply_days_cap_and_min_content, long-haul days → 'Flight Recovery Mobility' override, no 30+min strength card <3 exercises (A4 preserved on fallback path); (T4) programme_context_for_llm returns weekly_shape_ideal list, event_type_pref='marathon', session_type_meta dict, and progression block with phase/phase_label/week_index/target_sessions_per_week/sessions_planned_this_week/sessions_completed_this_week/sessions_missed_this_week/next_progression/deload_status; (T5) persist_programme_record stores weekly_shape_ideal + event_type_pref + progression on the programmes row (verified via Mongo find_one); (T6) Plan A validator rules regression — marathon-no-run → error, target+2 → hard error, >50% template → warning, 5x repeated title → warning, incomplete_content workouts → error; (T7) main_goal_key=build_muscle produces push/pull/leg/upper split with ZERO run titles; (T8) backend smoke — /api/auth/login (client), /api/auth/me, /api/programme/current all 200 with correct shape (no _id leaked). No blocker issues found; Plan B ships as designed.

critical_code_review_comments: event_weekly_shape correctly separates real training slots (top-N) from mobility/recovery padding (all trailing light slots) — deterministic and matches the fallback consumption pattern in build_template_plan.

build_template_plan reserves real training slots and only pops LIGHT slots on duty overrides — so a long-haul override never eats a Long Run slot. Verified by test_at_least_one_long_run_per_week + test_long_haul_days_get_flight_recovery passing simultaneously.

_apply_days_cap_and_min_content is now called on the fallback path too (server.py ~L3034) — verified via test_real_sessions_capped_at_training_days: 4-day cap holds even when fallback would otherwise place 5 real training slots.
_stub_for_session_type produces Long Run with key_session=True and focus='long_run' — protected from the days-cap demoter via the priority sort (key_session=0). Long Run always survives the cap.
programme_context_for_llm attaches weekly_shape_ideal from event_weekly_shape (endurance) OR strength_weekly_shape (else) — clean branch, no silent fall-through to a generic list.
persist_programme_record's idempotency-per-(user_id, roster_id) is intact — new B1/B3 fields (weekly_shape_ideal, event_type_pref, progression) are persisted on both insert AND update paths.
Validator rule 9 (endurance goal must have runs) reads event_type_pref off profile_snapshot inside context — ev_type var is bound but not required for the current 'has_run' check; safe.

STRENGTH_WEEKLY_SHAPES['build_muscle'] is 4 slots wide by design (push/pull/leg/upper) — if a client picks training_days_per_week=5, they'll only get 4 real strength sessions + mobility. Acceptable given the current target cap but worth noting for future 5+/wk clients.
